# Prescott Roofing

> Residential roofing contractor serving Southern New Hampshire and Northern Massachusetts. Roof replacement, roof repair, storm damage restoration, ice dam removal, gutters, and free roof inspections. Fully licensed and insured in NH and MA.

Based in Manchester, NH, Prescott Roofing helps homeowners protect their homes with precision craftsmanship and clear, honest communication. Free roof inspections can be booked online or by phone at 603-451-2224.

## Services

- [Roof Replacement](https://prescottroofingnh.com/services/roof-replacement): Full tear-off and replacement with proper decking repair, precision craftsmanship, and a final walkthrough.
- [Roof Repair](https://prescottroofingnh.com/services/roof-repair): Leak diagnosis, flashing repair, shingle replacement, and step flashing fixes done right the first time.
- [Storm Damage Restoration](https://prescottroofingnh.com/services/storm-damage): Documentation, Xactimate estimates, and adjuster support after wind and hail events.
- [Ice Dam Removal](https://prescottroofingnh.com/services/ice-dam-removal): Professional ice dam removal and prevention guidance for New England winters.
- [Gutters](https://prescottroofingnh.com/services/gutters): Gutter installation and repair to move water safely away from your home.
